draft_wording: The vision-to-imagery transformation is a novel concept we introduce
alternative_explanations: Roy et al. 2025 (PMC12424947) introduce exactly this: 'the concept of an imagery transformation - a mapping from visual to imagery activity patterns evoked by the same stimulus'

draft_wording: We can predict imagery fMRI activity from perception fMRI for held-out content
statistical_result: Roy et al: median Pearson r ~0.3-0.4 early visual, ~0.4-0.5 higher visual
alternative_explanations: Done by Roy et al. with reduced-rank linear voxel-to-voxel regression, 4-fold CV rank selection

draft_wording: The perception-to-imagery map is strongly non-invertible
alternative_explanations: I asserted this as measured fact. Roy et al. NEVER RAN THE INVERSE. Additionally alignment is ~100% in ventral/lateral/parietal ROIs, so contraction is early-visual only. Withdrawn.

draft_wording: Imagery halves the dimensionality of neural representations
alternative_explanations: Halving is EARLY VISUAL ONLY (d_im~2-3 vs d_vis~4-6 in V1/V2). Higher areas near parity. Imagery dimensionality is nearly CONSTANT across ROIs; the gap closes because vision expands.

draft_wording: Reconstructions of visual activity in imagery dimensions explain only 25-50% of variance
alternative_explanations: This is an ALIGNMENT RATIO (Roy Eq.10): the imagery subspace explains 25-30% (V1) to 50% (V4) of the variance in visual activity THAT IS EXPLAINED BY THE VISUAL SUBSPACE. A ratio of variance-explained, measuring subspace misalignment. Not an information-loss figure.

draft_wording: The imagery transformation is neural rather than a stimulus-identity effect
alternative_explanations: UNTESTED BY ANYONE. Roy et al. state their analysis is 'purely voxel-activity-to-voxel-activity' - no semantic control. With only 12 conditions in NSD-Imagery a model could predict imagery activity by implicitly identifying which of 12 stimuli it was.

draft_wording: Contraction spectra are shared across subjects (universal)
alternative_explanations: Roy et al. are entirely within-subject; no LOSO. BUT arXiv 2409.06843 reports a UNIVERSAL SCALE-FREE SPECTRUM in visual cortex generally - a shared spectrum may be a generic cortical property, not a transition property. Also requires subject-specific functional alignment or a null is methodological.

draft_wording: Directional information contraction occurs between mental states
alternative_explanations: ESTABLISHED FROM TWO DIRECTIONS: Roy et al. for perception->imagery; episodic-memory dimensionality transformation and 'A compressed code for memory discrimination' for perception->memory. Not our idea.

draft_wording: Vividness correlates with V1 imagery-subspace dimensionality
statistical_result: Roy et al: r=0.71, p<0.05, n=8, bootstrap 95% CI [0.15, 0.98]
alternative_explanations: THEIR result. The CI spans nearly the entire positive range at n=8 - a hypothesis, not an established effect. Replication at adequate n would be a legitimate service since it is being cited from a preprint.

draft_wording: Mental-state transitions obey composable or path-dependent laws
alternative_explanations: NO PUBLIC DATASET HAS >=3 STATES ON THE SAME CONTENT AT TRIAL LEVEL. Unmeasurable without MindStates-7T.

draft_wording: MINDIR is novel
alternative_explanations: Literature review is PARTIAL: 4 dataset families and several search families unaudited. No 'first' claim is authorized.

draft_wording: No public dataset has >=3 mental states on the same content at trial level
alternative_explanations: FALSE AS AN EXISTENCE CLAIM. Oedekoven et al. 2017 measured 21 participants watching, immediately retrieving, and retrieving after one week the SAME 24 videos. Three states, identical content. True statement: three-state data exist and are verified but are not openly downloadable at trial level (NeuroVault 2814 = group t-maps only); trial-level is available on reasonable request.

draft_wording: Mental-state transitions implement information contraction
alternative_explanations: REFUTED. Roy et al. show early-visual CONTRACTION for perception->imagery; Li Yang & Bao (Sci Adv 2026) show spatial EXPANSION for perception->working memory - robust ipsilateral representation engaging 70-90% of ipsilateral LOC, exceeding unilateral perception. Two internally-generated states reorganize in OPPOSITE geometric directions.

draft_wording: Mental-state transitions reorganize information via contraction/expansion/rotation/redistribution/noise
alternative_explanations: The revised theory. Supported by the CONJUNCTION of Roy (contraction) and Li/Yang/Bao (expansion). Not our discovery - it is what two published results jointly imply. Our question is whether WHICH information is retained follows reproducible regularities.

draft_wording: Immediate retrieval mediates what is retained after one week
alternative_explanations: Testable ONLY on Oedekoven trial-level data, which requires an author request that HAS NOT BEEN SENT. Must be called predictive factorization of multi-stage memory transformation, NOT causal path dependence - the route was not randomized, every participant went encoding->immediate->delayed.

draft_wording: We have access to the Oedekoven dataset
alternative_explanations: NO REQUEST HAS BEEN SENT. Sending correspondence to external researchers is outside autonomous authority. Access must never be described as pending, likely or probable until a reply grants it.

draft_wording: The identity-held-out test is valid at 12 identities
alternative_explanations: NARROWED. Correct statement: under the tested synthetic alternatives, complete identity holdout distinguishes a STRONG generalizable transformation from a condition-template null; empirical sensitivity at 12 identities is UNKNOWN. The 0.447 estimate, 0.93 asymptote, and attenuated-by-half claims were configuration-specific artifacts of an arbitrary noise regime and are withdrawn as design-level statements.

draft_wording: The primary estimand is unique neural contribution beyond stimulus features
statistical_result: LOIO variance partition, 12 seeds n_id=12: W0 -0.316, W1 -0.150, W2 +0.281, W3 +0.075
alternative_explanations: Raw held-out prediction is INSUFFICIENT because W1 (feature mediation) generalizes with no transformation present -- a condition-level map T=BA+ exists. Only unique-neural-beyond-features separates W1 from W2. Established on ground truth; not yet on real data.

draft_wording: Single-trial coupling averages away under Roy random pairing
alternative_explanations: WRONG. A LINEAR single-trial map induces a condition-level map on the means (averaging commutes with a linear operator), so W4's condition-level transform SURVIVES random pairing and is indistinguishable from W2 (unique neural ~0.24). Only trial-to-trial ALIGNMENT is non-identifiable. This makes the identifiability limitation STRONGER: the Roy design cannot separate a single-trial mechanism from a condition-level transformation.

draft_wording: Roy et al's empirical result is artifactual
alternative_explanations: The simulation does NOT show this and it is never to be presented as such. It shows only that the repeat-level protocol does not, by itself, identify cross-content generalization. Roy's actual result has not been reproduced.

draft_wording: Incremental source-state predictive value beyond the preregistered stimulus-feature battery (dR2_source|F)
statistical_result: least-favourable calibration n_id=12: max FPR 0.000, POWER 0.00, alt mean 0.213, W1f mean 0.470, W1c mean 0.017
alternative_explanations: CANONICAL NAME - never write 'unique neural contribution' unqualified. Positive values show information beyond the MEASURED battery only; they do NOT prove a direct neural mechanism and do NOT exclude unmeasured visual/semantic/attentional/subject-specific common causes (W1c). Negative values are a cross-validated predictive contrast, not negative information.

draft_wording: E-M1 can distinguish a genuine state transformation from a shared unobserved nuisance
statistical_result: W1f (unobserved shared condition-level attentional variable) mean dR2 +0.470 EXCEEDS the genuine transform's +0.213; least-favourable threshold 0.825 sits above the alternative; power 0.00
alternative_explanations: Under honest least-favourable calibration the detector is VALID (max FPR 0.000) but USELESS (power 0.00) at n_id=12. The nuisance must be MEASURED or excluded by design, not assumed away. Magnitudes are configuration-specific; the structural constraint transfers.

draft_wording: NSD-Imagery can support a state-transformation-specific (Level C) claim
alternative_explanations: NO. Public NSD-Imagery reaches Level B at best (incremental value over the MEASURED feature battery). Level C requires exhaustive controlled feature generation, factorial counterfactual stimuli, randomized state manipulation, or prospective prediction -- i.e. MindStates acquisition.

draft_wording: Max FPR 0.000 across the null family, criterion <=0.05 met
alternative_explanations: STATISTICALLY INVALID. Clopper-Pearson 95% CI for 0/15 is [0.000, 0.218] -- the true FPR could be 21.8%. At least 72 zero-event trials are needed to bound FPR<=0.05; target is 1000 per null with exact intervals. Every FPR must carry a binomial CI.

draft_wording: The unobserved nuisance is stronger than the genuine transformation
statistical_result: W1f mean dR2 +0.470 vs W2 +0.213, ONE unmatched parameter setting
alternative_explanations: UNMATCHED COMPARISON. W1f and W2 were not matched on source reliability, target reliability, source-target predictive correlation, effective rank, signal variance, or total explainable variance. Raw magnitudes say nothing about intrinsic strength. Withdrawn.

draft_wording: Some latent-common-cause configurations are observationally indistinguishable from a condition-level transformation
statistical_result: W1f_condition_locked_latent_common_cause reaches dR2 comparable to or exceeding W2 under some settings
alternative_explanations: The SURVIVING form of M-025. Establishes the identification limit without claiming the nuisance is intrinsically stronger. An unrestricted latent common cause makes direct causal interpretation unidentifiable by construction.

draft_wording: Task P (predictive Level-B) and Task C (latent-confound sensitivity) are distinct inferential problems
alternative_explanations: The M1.2 error was importing an UNRESTRICTED worst-case latent confound as the primary rejection threshold for a PREDICTIVE test, which guarantees zero power by construction. Task C is a partial-identification sensitivity frontier, not a binary test, and must not set Task P's threshold.

Denoising architecture specified; only fold-level ambiguous. Independent method reproduction FEASIBLE after data access.
